⚰️ Naxxramas

"Kel'Thuzad's floating necropolis, hauled from the skies of the Eastern Plaguelands to Dragonblight and retuned as WotLK's opening 10/25-man raid. Four themed wings — Arachnid, Plague, Military and Construct — each sealed behind a gatekeeper, then the frost-breath gauntlet of Sapphiron and the archlich himself. Home of the Tier 7 sets (Heroes'/Valorous Dreadnaught, Redemption, Cryptstalker and kin) and the Kel'Thuzad weapons."

🎯 Naxx Loot Summary

Equipment Focus: Tier 7 raid armour (10-man Heroes'/25-man Valorous tokens), the Kel'Thuzad melee and caster weapons, and a full spread of off-set epics across all four wings — the standard fresh-80 raid entry point.

  • Best for: Level 80 (entry raid tier)
  • Raid size: 10 or 25 players
  • Boss levels: 83 (Elite)
  • Famous for: Tier 7 sets, Kel'Thuzad's weapons (Betrayer of Humanity, Calamity's Grasp), the Heigan safety-dance and Thaddius polarity mechanics
  • Includes: Fifteen encounters across four wings plus Sapphiron and Kel'Thuzad — the Four Horsemen loot drops from the Four Horsemen Chest
